03 / About

Technology should amplify our humanity, not ask us to adapt to the machine.

I am a designer and maker working with Arduino, sensors, sound, light, 3D printing and ergonomic prototyping. My practice moves between care-focused products and critical narratives about the systems shaping everyday life.

Currently based in London and studying MA Design for Industry 5.0 at University of the Arts London.

Critical Interaction Design · 2025

SPACE JUNK
DIALYSIS

Making an invisible cost bodily.

SPACE JUNK DIALYSIS imagines a near future in which the metallic residue of orbital debris has entered the atmosphere and the bloodstream. A fictional dialysis apparatus filters these particles from the body, transforming a planetary-scale issue into an intimate encounter.

Airflow sensing and a TouchDesigner interface connect the visitor’s gestures to the apparatus. Light, sound and moving fluid build a clinical yet theatrical experience: the audience is not shown a statistic, but placed inside its possible consequence.

Role
Concept, interaction, prototyping, visual direction
Tools
Arduino, airflow sensors, TouchDesigner, 3D printing

Interactive Installation · 2025

LABOUR
TOWER

A monument powered by invisible labour.

LABOUR TOWER is an interactive kinetic sculpture about the human cost concealed beneath digital economies. Visitors feed the tower with coins representing units of labour. As participation increases, the tower glows brighter and its sound becomes more distorted.

The work mirrors our complicity in systems that consume individual time and energy to sustain an image of frictionless technological prosperity.

Role
Concept, form, electronics, interaction
Tools
Arduino, motors, light, sound, digital fabrication
